info.title: TRIMME API
info.description: Public, customer, shop and admin API for the TRIMME salon and barber booking marketplace.

get.summary: API name, version and current server time (UTC).
A stored image (JPEG, PNG or WebP). Public and immutable: a new upload always gets a new id.
The signed-in user with roles and permissions.
The signed-in shop user's shop, from the session (never from the request).
An active shop's public profile. No professional or customer contact data.
The shop's own professionals, read-only and without contact data.
Active professionals of an active shop. No contact data.
Active service categories, in display order.
An active shop's published services (active, not archived, not hidden).
An active shop's published packages whose every service is available.

put.summary: Sets one of the shop's own professionals' weekly hours (never their profile).

get.summary: Shop subscriptions by status (most urgent end date first), with counts over every shop.
The signed-in shop's own subscription and renewal history (read-only).
Issues the CSRF cookie and returns its value for the X-CSRF-Token header.

post.summary: Sends a 6-digit sign-in code to a Saudi mobile number (customers).
Verifies the code, signs the customer in (creating the account if new) and sets the session cookies.
Saves a new customer's name, language and terms acceptance.
Shop and admin staff sign in with email and password.
Emails a password-reset link to a staff account. Always returns 202.
Sets a new staff password from an emailed link and signs out every device.
Creates a staff account from an emailed invitation and signs it in.
Rotates the refresh cookie and re-issues the access cookie.
Ends the current session and clears the session cookies.

get.summary: The signed-in user's active sessions (devices).

delete.summary: Signs out one of the user's own sessions.

post.summary: Signs out every other device; the current session stays signed in.

get.summary: The permission catalogue.
Roles with their granted permissions.

post.summary: Emails a platform-admin invitation for the given admin role.
Emails a ShopOwner or ShopStaff invitation for one shop (audited).
Creates a shop in Draft status.

get.summary: Shops, newest first, with search (name, slug, district) and status filter (paged).
One shop with its profile, location and shop-edit policy.

put.summary: Edits the public profile and verification (audited, optimistic concurrency).

post.summary: Activates a draft or suspended shop (audited).
Suspends a shop; its users lose access to shop data immediately (audited).

put.summary: Sets the confirmed map point and address (audited).
Sets which profile fields the shop may edit itself (audited).
Replaces the logo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB; audited).
Replaces the cover image (1600×900 recommended; audited).

post.summary: Adds a gallery image (up to 12; audited).

get.summary: The shop's own profile and the admin's edit policy. Not available while suspended.

put.summary: Edits the fields the admin policy opens to the shop; a locked field that changes answers 403.
Replaces the logo, if the policy allows.

delete.summary: Removes the logo, if the policy allows.

put.summary: Replaces the cover image, if the policy allows.

delete.summary: Removes the cover image, if the policy allows.

post.summary: Adds a gallery image, if the policy allows.

delete.summary: Removes one of the shop's gallery images, if the policy allows.

put.summary: Sets the shop's map point, if the admin policy opens the location to the shop.

get.summary: Whether the shop's online booking is paused (D-013).

post.summary: Stops new online bookings and availability; confirmed appointments stay (audited).
Takes online bookings again (audited).

get.summary: Address and district search for the location picker (server-side provider, cached).
The address at a map point, for the picker's confirmation card.
Address and district search for the location picker (server-side provider, cached).
The address at a map point, for the picker's confirmation card.

post.summary: Creates a professional in exactly one shop (audited).

get.summary: Professionals with shop, status and search filters (paged). Numbers are masked.
One professional. The WhatsApp number is masked.

put.summary: Edits the profile (audited, optimistic concurrency). The shop cannot change.

post.summary: Hides the professional from booking (audited).
Makes a disabled professional active again (audited).

put.summary: Sets or corrects the WhatsApp number and the notification toggle (audited, number never logged).

post.summary: Returns the full number once, for a stated reason (audited; never cached).

put.summary: Replaces the photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB; audited).

get.summary: The shop's own services in display order (archived ones on request).

post.summary: Creates a service with the shop's own name, price and duration.

get.summary: One of the shop's own services; another shop's id is 404.

put.summary: Edits the shop's own service (optimistic concurrency).

delete.summary: Deletes a service nothing uses yet; otherwise 409 service.in_use (archive instead).

post.summary: Turns the service on.
Turns the service off.
Retires the service for good; history keeps it.

put.summary: Sets the display order from the full list of non-archived services.

get.summary: The shop's own packages, with whether each is currently bookable.

post.summary: Creates a package of the shop's own services.

get.summary: One of the shop's own packages.

put.summary: Edits the package and its items (optimistic concurrency).

post.summary: Turns the package on.
Turns the package off.
Retires the package for good.

put.summary: Sets the display order from the full list of non-archived packages.

get.summary: All categories with how many active shop services use each.

post.summary: Creates a category (no price or duration: those are the shops').

put.summary: Edits a category (audited).

post.summary: Offers the category again.
Stops offering the category for new services; existing ones keep it.

get.summary: Shop services across the platform, each with its shop's own price and duration (paged).
One shop service.

post.summary: Hides a service from customers (reason required) or shows it again (audited).

put.summary: Support correction of one shop service, with a reason; audited before → after.

get.summary: Shop packages across the platform (paged).

post.summary: Hides a package from customers (reason required) or shows it again (audited).

get.summary: The professional's own shop's services, with that shop's prices, and which are assigned.

put.summary: Replaces the assigned services; only the professional's own shop's services (audited).

get.summary: Opening hours, professionals' hours, current and upcoming closures, breaks and time off.

put.summary: Replaces the weekly opening hours; applies from now on, bookings are never cancelled.

post.summary: Closes the shop on whole days (no slots on those business days).

put.summary: Edits a closure (optimistic concurrency).

post.summary: Upcoming bookings the closure would overlap (nothing is saved or cancelled).
Adds a weekly or one-off break for one professional or everyone.

put.summary: Edits a break (optimistic concurrency).

post.summary: Upcoming bookings (within the booking horizon) the break would overlap.
Records a professional's time off (vacation, sick leave…).

put.summary: Edits time off (same professional; optimistic concurrency).

post.summary: Upcoming bookings of the professional the time off would overlap.

get.summary: Bookable slot counts per local date (default: 14 days from today, at most 31) for a service or package, one professional or any.
Only genuinely bookable starts of one local date, with the professionals free for each (any professional when none is given).
Every plan in display order, with its current price and full price history.

post.summary: Creates a draft plan (SuperAdmin).

get.summary: One plan with its price history.

put.summary: Edits a plan's details (SuperAdmin; optimistic concurrency). Existing subscriptions keep their snapshots.

post.summary: Offers the plan (it needs a price).
Stops offering the plan; existing subscriptions may still renew on it.
Retires the plan for good; history keeps it.

put.summary: Sets the display order of every non-archived plan (SuperAdmin).

get.summary: The plan's price versions, newest first.

post.summary: Adds a price version from a date (today or later). It applies only to periods starting on or after that date.

get.summary: A shop's subscription: status, current period, every renewal and override.

post.summary: Starts the shop's subscription on a published plan; the price in force on the start date is recorded.
Records a renewal period (no payment in v1); earlier periods never change.
SuperAdmin shop-specific price and/or end date for the period in force, with a reason (audited).
Suspends the subscription (reason required). Existing bookings are not touched.
Lifts a suspension.

get.summary: The platform settings: booking policy, reminders, subscription enforcement, map defaults.

put.summary: Edits the platform settings (audited, optimistic concurrency).

AddPlanPriceRequest.description: A new price version in the platform currency, effective from today or a later date.

AdminProfessionalListItem.description: A professional in the admin list.

AdminProfessionalResponse.description:
A professional as the platform admin edits it. Guid AdminProfessionalResponse.ShopId is read-only: it is fixed at creation and no
request can change it (R-NEG-01).

AdminShopDetailResponse.description: A shop with its full profile, location and shop-edit policy, as the platform admin edits it.

AdminShopResponse.description: A shop in the admin list.

AdminShopSubscriptionResponse.description:
A shop's subscription for admins. `Exists` is false (status `None`) until a plan is assigned;
`NextStart` is the default start date of the next assignment or renewal.

AdminWhatsAppResponse.description: The WhatsApp settings an admin sees. The number itself is only ever masked here (reveal is a separate, audited action).

AffectedBookingResponse.description: An upcoming booking that a new break, time off or closure would overlap. Never carries a phone number.

AssignSubscriptionRequest.description:
Starts a shop's subscription. `StartDate` defaults to today (it cannot be in the future); the end follows the
plan's interval. A custom `DurationDays`, a past start or an explicit `Price` is a SuperAdmin override: it
needs `SuperAdmin.Subscriptions.Override`, the explicit total `Price` and a `Reason` (D-081).

AvailabilitySlotResponse.description:
A bookable start (D-009: only genuinely bookable slots are returned). `LocalTime` is `HH:mm` in the
shop's time zone; `ProfessionalIds` are every professional free for the whole item (D-012 candidates).

AvailableDatesResponse.description: Every date from `From` to `To` with its number of bookable slots (0 = none), for the date strip.

AvailableSlotsResponse.description:
Slots of one local date. When the shop takes no online bookings right now (paused, subscription not in force…),
`Bookable` is false, `BlockedReason` says why and there are no slots (D-013, D-078).

BreakRequest.description:
A break for one professional or everyone (`ProfessionalId` null): weekly on `Weekdays`, or once on
`Date` (exactly one of the two). Minutes from local midnight, within the day, on 5-minute steps.

BreakResponse.description: A break; `ProfessionalId` null means everyone. Weekly (weekdays) or once (date).

ClosureRequest.description: Closed days, inclusive. `Version` is needed to edit.

ConflictPreviewResponse.description:
Bookings the change would overlap. Nothing is cancelled or messaged automatically (DV-S22): the shop sees them and
decides.

CreatePlanRequest.description: A new plan (Draft). `InitialPrice`, when given, becomes price version 1 from today.

CreateProfessionalRequest.description: The one shop is chosen here, at creation, and can never be changed afterwards (D-011).

CreateShopPackageRequest.description: A package of 2–10 of the shop's own services, with its own price and total duration.

CreateShopServiceRequest.description: A new service of the signed-in shop. Price in SAR (≤ 2 decimals); duration a multiple of 5 minutes.

DayPeriod.description: Where a slot sits in the day (D-009 groups the slot grid by period).

GeocodedPlace.description: An address search or reverse-geocoding result.

HoursIntervalDto.description:
One weekly interval: minutes from the weekday's local midnight. `EndMinute` may pass 1440 when the window
closes after midnight (21:00–02:00 is 1260–1560).

LocationSource.description: How the location point was chosen in the picker.

MeResponse.description:
The signed-in user (`GET /api/v1/me`). `UserType` is `Customer`, `ShopUser` or
`PlatformAdmin`. A customer sees only their own number, masked. `ShopId` is set for shop users from
Phase 05. `ProfileComplete` is false until a customer has given a name and accepted the terms.

ModerationRequest.description: Hide needs a reason (audited); unhide does not.

ModerationState.description: Platform moderation of a shop's service or package (DV-S02). A hidden item is never published.

OnlineBookingStateResponse.description:
Whether the shop takes online bookings right now (s-hours pause card, D-013). While paused the shop gets no new
online bookings and no availability; confirmed appointments stay, and walk-ins still work.

OpeningHoursRequest.description: The whole week of opening hours. Send the `Version` read (null only before the first save); stale → 409.

OpeningHoursResponse.description: The shop's weekly opening hours. `Version` is null until the shop saves its hours for the first time.

OtpChallengeResponse.description: Response to an OTP request. The code is never returned.

OverrideServiceRequest.description: Support correction of one shop service. A reason is required and the change is audited.

OverrideSubscriptionRequest.description: SuperAdmin override of the period in force: a shop-specific price and/or end date, with a reason.

PagedResponseOfAdminPackageListItem.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PagedResponseOfAdminProfessionalListItem.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PagedResponseOfAdminServiceListItem.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PagedResponseOfAdminShopResponse.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PauseOnlineBookingRequest.description: Pausing online booking; the optional reason is the shop's own note (≤ 300 characters).

PlanOrderRequest.description: Every non-archived plan, in the new order.

PlanResponse.description:
A plan as SuperAdmin manages it. `CurrentPrice` is the version in force today (platform calendar) and
`UpcomingPrice` the next scheduled one; `Prices` is the full history, newest first.

PlanStatus.description: Draft (being prepared) → Published (offered) → Inactive (not offered, may return) → Archived (final).

ProfessionalHoursResponse.description: A professional's weekly hours as the shop manages them (no contact data).

ProfessionalServicesResponse.description: The professional's own shop's services (with that shop's prices) and which are assigned (DV-S04).

PublicPackageResponse.description: A published package: itself and every item service are available.

PublicProfessionalResponse.description: A professional on the public shop page. Never carries a phone or WhatsApp number (R-PRO-02).

PublicServiceResponse.description: A published service: active, not archived, not hidden by the platform. `NameEn` may be null (D-070).

PublicShopLocationResponse.description: Where a customer finds the shop: the confirmed point and the address, without who confirmed it.

PublicShopResponse.description:
A published shop's basic profile (`GET /public/shops/{slug}`). Only active shops are published. The phone is the
shop's own business number; professional and customer numbers are never part of a public contract (R-PRO-02).

RenewSubscriptionRequest.description:
Records a renewal; the plan defaults to the current one and the start to the day after the current end (or today
after a lapse). Custom durations, past starts and explicit prices follow the same SuperAdmin rule as activation.

ReorderRequest.description: Every non-archived item of the shop, in the new order.

RevealedWhatsAppResponse.description: The full number, returned once per audited reveal. Never cached.

ScheduleEntryState.description: Whether a closure or time off is in force now or still ahead (past entries are not listed).

SetProfessionalWhatsAppRequest.description:
Sets, corrects or removes (null) the WhatsApp number (E.164 or a Saudi national format), and the notification
toggle. With `KeepCurrentNumber` only the toggle changes, so an admin never needs to see the number to do that.

ShopCategory.description: Kind of business, shown on the public page and used by discovery filters (Phase 11).

ShopLocationResponse.description: The confirmed shop entrance. Coordinates are WGS 84 decimal degrees.

ShopPackageResponse.description: A shop's own package. `IsBookable` is false while any item service is off, archived or hidden.

ShopProfessionalResponse.description:
A professional as the shop sees it (read-only: the shop cannot create, edit or move professionals, spec §7).
Shop-facing contract: no contact data of any kind.

ShopProfileField.description: Profile areas an admin can open to or lock from the shop (DV-S16). Verification and slug are never shop-editable.

ShopProfileResponse.description:
The signed-in shop user's own shop (`GET /api/v1/shop/me`). Shop-facing contract: it must never carry customer
contact data (R-NEG-04). The status is reported even while suspended, so the dashboard can explain it.

ShopScheduleResponse.description: Everything the s-hours screen shows, for the signed-in shop.

ShopServiceResponse.description:
A shop's own service as the shop manages it. Shop-facing contract: no customer data. `NameEn` may be null;
clients show the Arabic name instead (D-070).

ShopSubscriptionResponse.description: The signed-in shop's own subscription, read-only (renewals go through the platform admins).

SignInResponse.description:
Result of a successful sign-in; the session cookies are set on the response. `IsNewUser` is true when the OTP
verification (or an invitation) created the account.

SubscriptionCounts.description: Counts over every shop (a shop without a subscription counts as `None`).

SubscriptionEnforcement.description: What happens to a shop whose platform subscription is not in force (D-014).

SubscriptionPeriodResponse.description: One recorded period with the plan name and price as they were charged (never recomputed).

SubscriptionStatus.description: Spec §15 statuses. `None` is a shop that has never had a subscription.

TimeOffRequest.description:
Time off from `StartDate` to `EndDate` (inclusive, shop-local). Without minutes it covers whole days;
otherwise it starts at `StartMinute` of the first day and ends at `EndMinute` of the last.

TimeOffResponse.description:
Time off. `StartDate`/`EndDate` are the shop-local days it covers (inclusive); the minutes are null for an
all-day entry.

UpdateOwnShopProfileRequest.description: The shop's own edit. Send the whole form: fields locked by the admin policy must keep their current value.

UpdatePlanRequest.description: Edits a plan's details; prices change only through a new price version.

UpdatePlatformSettingsRequest.description: The editable platform settings; a stale `Version` answers 409.

UpdateProfessionalRequest.description: Profile edit. There is deliberately no shop field: a professional cannot be moved to another shop.

UpdateShopProfileRequest.description:
The admin's profile edit. `Version` is the value the client read; a stale value answers 409
`resource.concurrency_conflict`.

UpdateShopServiceRequest.description: Edit of the shop's own service; a stale `Version` answers 409.

WhatsAppVerification.description: Delivery state of the WhatsApp number, set by the notification worker (Phase 15).

WorkingHoursRequest.description: A professional's hours: follow the shop's opening hours, or their own weekly intervals.
